integrity: The infinite statement is proved analytically. Exhaustive computation through order eight is corroborative only. The earliest public date is the posted date of preprint version 1; the peer-reviewed article was published later.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers connected complete multipartite graphs with every part of size at least two and determines only the minimum total triple Roman domination weight, not the optimizer count.
title: Total triple Roman domination of complete multipartite graphs without universal vertices
